Title: Forms Audit Trail
Description:
A view-only audit trail for Umbraco Forms design changes. It tracks who changed what on form designs (fields, pages, workflows and form settings) and shows the history in a backoffice dashboard with filtering, field-level diffs and CSV export.

Umbraco Forms 17.6 and 18.2 keep a history on each form and can roll it back. This package adds one view across all forms, with field-level changes, filtering, CSV export and a record that outlasts deleted forms.
